name: orbit-gallery
title: Orbit gallery
description: Nine photos spiral in around a title and settle on an ellipse.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many photographs land on the ring.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title in the middle.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A small line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: radiusX
props.doc: Half the width of the ring they settle on, in px.

props.name: radiusY
props.doc: Half the height of the ring they settle on, in px.

props.name: photoWidth
props.doc: Width of a photograph, in px.

props.name: photoHeight
props.doc: Height of a photograph, in px.

props.name: swirl
props.doc: How many degrees each photograph winds round the title on its way in.

props.name: startDistance
props.doc: How far out they start, as a multiple of the ring.

props.name: firstFrame
props.doc: Frame the first photograph starts moving.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one photograph setting off and the next.

props.name: travelFrames
props.doc: Frames each photograph takes to arrive.

props.name: tilt
props.doc: How far each photograph lies from square once settled, in degrees.

props.name: seed
props.doc: Seed for the tilt and the order. Same seed, same ring.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: openZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the opening shot on the title.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the camera pushes in once the ring has settled (0.06 is 6 percent).

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the subtitle.

props.name: serif
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the title.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Subtitle.
